description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MultipartUploadingTrait' that provides methods to manage multipart upload processes in AWS S3, such as retrieving upload state, handling upload results, and calculating part sizes.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Creates and retrieves an UploadState object for a multipart upload by querying AWS S3 for existing uploaded parts and setting the upload state accordingly.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Handles the results of a upload part operation, updating the upload state with the part's ETag and other metadata.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by the consuming class; extracts ETag from the AWS SDK Result object.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters required to complete a multipart upload based on the current upload state and configuration.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Calculates and validates the size of each upload part, ensuring it adheres to AWS S3 constraints.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters to initiate a multipart upload, including setting ACLs and content type.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current UploadState instance.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the configuration array for the upload.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Abstract method to get the total size of the source data being uploaded.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the MIME type of the source data.
